Rumors about the treatment of the Exemplars spreads amongst the rank and file. No one wants Parliament to disband the unit, with their heroic accomplishments. Lieutenant Shearer continues to be plagued by the injuries he suffered during the war.

During the war, soldiers fought side-by-side and sang songs together, as they marched towards victory. Today, however, things are not as they have hoped, and Vina is not happy with what she has been able to achieve for the city.

The workers have established the Londinium Industry Development Association with parliamentary support following the end of the war. Feist, now acting as its consultant, is active in the development of new technology and assisting with rebuilding. Shortages of resources remain a source of conflict, however.

Vina has her hands full with the problems of the city. The Glasgow Gang do their best to help in their own way. Delphine appears before Shearer, who continues to suffer from lingering symptoms, and promises to take him back to Lynncardine.

Vina finally decides to represent Parliament by publicly declaring a series of future programs, including one aimed at resettling the Exemplars. Though the sudden and secretive arrival of the dukes in the city alongside the theft of the crown leads to new troubles.

The retired soldier who stole the crown willingly appears before Vina, attempting to persuade her to become the king she envisioned. Yet Vina chooses to leave the throne vacant, with the crown resting upon it.

The Exemplars, led by Vina, press forward relentlessly after breaking through the blockade at the city walls. Before the final battle, Vina hands the Realmblade to the people. She rallies soldiers, workers, and all manner of city dwellers to storm the Sarkaz's final stronghold together.

After the final battle, victory is secured and the Steam Knight's mission is complete. Allerdale bids farewell to Vina before vanishing into the steam. Vina faces the dukes to address Londinium's many issues.

Vina bids farewell to the crown stealer who loves Victoria and tells her a tale steeped in ambiguity—how, after the war is won, she declines the coronation offered by the supposedly deceased King Alistair II.
Vina confronts the dukes' provocation directly, reclaiming resources for the people of Londinium and formally declaring she will not become king. Meanwhile, the Glasgow Gang returns to Norport.

The Glasgow Gang returns home. Here, things are largely the same, but the people have changed. After they bemoan the lack of Vina, Vina shows up by her hungover friends' side. The war is finally over.

Nuova Volsinii prepares for the Carnevale to celebrate its first anniversary. While City Hall releases a promotional video and citizens prepare masks and costumes, mayor-elect Leontuzzo is caught in a car accident.

Eirene, president of the Truckers' Union, requested by Judge Lavinia, helps investigate the hit-and-run, only to learn that the culprit is her friend—a truck driver named Sommer. Meanwhile, Lavinia has become suspicious of Demetri, the man who invited Leontuzzo to the banquet.

Nuova Volsinii is currently free of mafiosi, but the famiglie have not given up on infiltrating the city. They're trying to use 'companies' to make inroads into the Truckers' Union. Eirene learns that her friend was the one who, while smuggling for the Venezia family, accidentally injured Leontuzzo.

Her options dwindling, Eirene decides to go ask Judge Lavinia for help. However, after sitting in on the court proceedings, she changes her mind and gets into a taxi driven by the White Wolf. After returning to Nuova Volsinii, Texas takes out the invitation she got from Lappland.

To protect the Truckers' Union, Eirene strikes a deal with Alberto to hand over the truck carrying the famiglie's goods to the Saluzzos. But when the two of them arrive at the place where the truck has been stashed, a giant float suddenly bursts into flames.

To find out the truth of how her daughter Suzuran got hurt, a former Famiglia Venezia assassin, Ingrid, accepts a request from a Signore dei Lupi to protect his Fang—an old tailor. The tailor's grandson unexpectedly witnesses a car accident while out on a delivery, and is abducted by Venezia mafiosi.

Lavinia and Demetri meet in a winery. She suspects him of being involved with the accident, but chances upon Ingrid who is asking around about the news, and the two get acquainted. After Ingrid leaves, Lavinia finds out the Vulpo lady was in fact at the scene on that very night.

Lavinia pursues Ingrid, but the head of the Venezia Trucking Co, Venezia Junior steps in personally to end the chase. Ingrid refuses his invitation to return to the family, but she then learns from Lappland that the old tailor's grandson is currently being held within the Venezia residence.

The old tailor learns where his grandson is, and decides to go to the Venezia residence to face Venezia Sr., his former employer. To fulfill her promise to the Signore dei Lupi, Ingrid decides to accompany Umberto and return to the family she left many years ago.

Venezia Senior decides to let the old tailor and his grandson leave as a testament to the famiglia's creed of 'decency'. Ingrid returns the family crest to him, officially leaving the Venezias, and bids farewell to the old Venezia who have treated her as his own daughter.

After witnessing the tragic death of her master, Lyudmila seeks a way to avenge her by taking down Red, but to no avail. In the end, she collapses in exhaustion out in the wilds, and is brought to the Truckers' Union by Sommer, who accidentally passes by.

Lyudmila stays at the Truckers' Union, slowly becoming a part of the truckers' lives. On the night of the car crash, Sommer avoids the other drivers to go out on a drive of his own. Sensing something amiss, Lyudmila sits herself down on his passenger seat.
The clash between Projekt Red and Lunacub unexpectedly causes a crash between Sommer's truck and Leontuzzo's limo. Facing down Projekt Red once again, the enraged Lyudmila chases her alone.

Lyudmila returns to the camp and finds out that Sommer has not returned. Consumed by guilt, she searched for him and eventually arrived at the port, where she discovered weapons smuggled inside the missing truck. To stop the Truckers' Union from getting entangled in more trouble, Lyudmila lights a fire.

Out on the wastes, Lappland finds a wrecked taxi and returns to Nuova Volsinii with Zaaro to join in the fun at Carnevale. On the night of the car accident, she witnesses everything unfold from the roof of a high-rise building—a wonderful show is staged and set.

A vehicle from the Truckers' Union is what caused the fire, for which Eirene is arrested and put on trial. However, Alberto and Venezia Junior tacitly plead her innocence. Lappland and Texas reunite, witnessing both the port blaze and the entire court hearing.

Lappland passes Eirene's case file to Lavinia, who realizes the connection between the truckers and the famiglie, and she takes the initiative to confront the two families in order to stop the situation from spiraling out of control.

Venezia Junior finds out about the city hall and court's actions, forces Venezia Senior to 'retire', and decides to take over the city during Carnevale. Eirene finds out that the Truckers' Union has never escaped the famiglia's shadow, and decides to organize the drivers to separate themselves from the mob.

Emperor and High Priest help repair the floats. Ingrid discovers the identity of the culprit that she is pursuing. The old tailor suggests she leave. Gambino controls the port's dispatch at Venezia Junior's orders, but Lappland shows up.

The streets are packed for Carnevale. Masked citizens and floats built in the image of beasts parade through the city. Famiglia Venezia attempts to occupy the courthouse, but find dozens of trucks in their way.

The truck drivers are locked in a standoff against the mafiosi. Lappland drives the cargo landship straight into the city and litters the square with Venezia's smuggled weapons, bringing to light what had heretofore been a power struggle under the surface.

The old tailor dies before Red's eyes. Ingrid kills the true culprit, Venezia Junior. Lappland and Texas make a bet on whether the parade will arrive to a sea of blood. Both mafiosi and truck drivers grab weapons. Tensions run high when a shot rings out.

The two sides in the standoff lay down their weapons, and the parade arrives at Court Square without incident. Lappland hands her mask to Texas, who wins their bet. Leontuzzo arrives at the scene, escorted by Demetri, and gives the closing address.

Venezia Senior pays a hefty price to protect Venezia Trucking. Lyudmila bids farewell to Eirene, after warning her against her hidden thoughts. The Signori dei Lupi game ends, but humanity's power struggles persist as always. Lappland becomes the new alpha.

Thorns tries to escape from a group of bandits who have kidnapped him, but unfortunately, he is trussed up once more, and hung upside down from a flagpole as a warning. Within the den of thieves, the bandit leader Juana's crew disapproves of her recent decisions.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Upside Down on the Pale Sea
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Two weeks ago, Thorns, who had come to Iberia in search of a sword technique, is knocked unconscious by a saltfin, and has an unexpected encounter with Pascuala, who is being chased by a sheriff intent on executing her. After dealing with the Alguacil Anastasio, the pair head to the town of Aarón.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Upside Down on the Pale Sea
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Thorns excavates a grave to find the sword technique he seeks, but is mistaken for a grave robber. Pascuala is also caught stealing. As the two are about to be hanged, a gang of bandits rushes the execution grounds, rescuing them and spiriting them away.
Thorns refuses to fix the compass for Juana, and it seems the sailors support his decision behind their leader's back. Meanwhile, Elysium and Weedy come to Aarón to find the missing Thorns.
Thanks to a lack of supplies, the sailors prepare to take Thorns out saltfin hunting. Juana appears to be hiding some dread secret having to do with the Seaborn.
Juana leads the finning team into the Salt Flat to hunt a massive saltfin. Anastasio is waiting on the path of their return.
Juana kills the massive saltfin after a deadly battle, but it is taken by Anastasio and Silver in an ambush. The crew barely escapes, and begins to accept Thorns as one of their own.
Silver and Anastasio disagree over the treatment of the captured crew. Elysium has infiltrated the camp and manages to find Thorns, who has agreed to help Juana repair the compass.
Unrest begins to spread through the camp due to a lack of supplies. Javier wants to surrender to the town with the crew. Anastasio begins to harbor thoughts about Aarón that he should not.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Let the Light of the Past Die
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: The compass repairs do not go well. The sailors plan a mutiny. Thorns kills the sword-wielding Seaborn under Juana's direction and learns the sword technique that fights the wind and waves.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Let the Light of the Past Die
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: The conflict within the fleet intensifies. Pascuala's golden tongue buys some time, but Thorns's alchemy fails. Javier goes to town to seek a way out for the crew from the Inquisition's persecution.
Anastasio leads the raid on the pirate camp. Juana lets Thorns go, but he returns when he sees the light from the fire in the distance.

After rescuing Juana, Thorns heads to the alchemy lab to retrieve his tools, encountering Anastasio in search of the compass. He escapes by triggering an explosion. The crew then flees toward Skeletal Reef to evade their pursuers.

Thorns resumes his repair work on the compass. The crew flees towards the reef, not knowing what the future holds. Back at town, Silver, who had given his entire life to Aarón, was judged by a resurrected Anastasio as having developed desires he should not have, and is executed.
Anastasio musters a party to pursue Thorns and the rest. La Conquista is hit and Thorns puts his hand into an Arts energy field to salvage the collapsing Corazonix.
With Anastasio in hot pursuit, Juana has no choice but to steer the ship into the valley of gushing steam. The final showdown looms near.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: I Come, I Conquer, I Define
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Javier proves to Juana that he can lead the crew towards a different future. Forced into desperate straits in his fight against Anastasio, Thorns leaps into the gushing steam.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: I Come, I Conquer, I Define
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Thorns cuts through the steam and defeats Anastasio. With the crisis over, the crew decides their respective futures. Juana dances one last time under the sunset.
Everyone makes a choice about the future they want. Some sailors choose to return to town with Javier, while others sail out to sea with Thorns and Juana. Pascuala sets off to seek a good life.

act40side.name: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Chrysanthemum Tea with Dried Tangerine Peels
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Four decades ago, news of the True Lung's death sent shockwaves throughout Yan. One rainy spring night, a prince and a scholar hurried their families out of Baizao.

Blaze follows Leizi to Baizao in search of the truth of her origins. As all of Baizao prepares for the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies, a feeling of unease permeates the city. Blaze visits a small eatery, where she enjoys a familiar dish.

Leizi returns to the Judicial Review Office for the trial of Yu Cheng, a former deputy minister of the Office. Yu Cheng has turned himself in, claiming to be the one who burned down the archives in the scrollery. Yu Cheng's strange behavior leads Leizi to believe he may have an ulterior motive. Leizi decides to review old cases that Yu Cheng once investigated.

Through deduction, Leizi identifies the person most directly connected to the two old cases—Ning Shu, the retired Minister of Rites. That same day, Liang Xun, the Advisor of Yumen, also appears at Ning's manor.

Xingzhu takes Blaze all over Baizao in search of the tangerine cakes she remembers, but they do not find them. Eventually, the Young Chef suggests that Mo Bufu, head chef of Ding Feng Lou, might know how to make them.

Blaze is determined to take part in the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies Chef Selection Competition, so the Young Chef starts giving her special culinary training. Unfortunately, her horrid cooking skills give him a real headache. Meanwhile, Xingzhu patiently accompanies Blaze and gives her advice. A bowl of longevity noodles brings back a lot of memories for the two.
The Young Chef gives Blaze's longevity noodles his seal of approval. Leizi finds another way to access the Academy's archives, allowing her to take her investigation in a new direction.

Blaze goes to Ding Feng Lou to take part in the Chef Selection for the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies; coincidentally, Leizi is investigating there. Out of sheer luck, Blaze stumbles her way through the qualifiers and meets Mo Bufu, when the Ding Feng Lou venue suddenly catches fire.

Blaze rescues Mo Bufu from the fire, who turns out to be the witness Leizi is after. Just as Leizi seeks to question him, Chen Che of the Judicial Review Office arrives with her force, putting the whole place under lockdown.

In far off Lungmen, Wei Yenwu receives an invitation from the capital, prompting him to recall the turbulent tale of how he departed it. Leizi is brought back to the Judicial Review Office, where the minister Chen Che takes pains to dissuade her from chasing down any more of Blaze's history.

Blaze is invited to the Ning Manor, where Xingzhu confesses to being a daughter of the Nings, and to having met Blaze's father before. Elsewhere, Jie Zhen finds Leizi, and hints to Leizi that she should stay staunch and see the investigation through to the end.

Blaze and Leizi meet up again, and the two decide to head to the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. Elsewhere, the time has come for the Yanese imperial court to decide on the matter of the bestial Sui. The True Lung is set to announce his verdict at the Feast.

Hundreds of mandarins gather before the Feast of a Hundred Delicacies. During this time, the Grand Commandant's Messenger finds Zuo Xuanliao overseeing Yumen. Leizi and Blaze sneak into the Feast, and just as Leizi stands up to remonstrate with the True Lung, a great conflagration overtakes the banquet.

Chaos reigns in the banquet hall, and Xingzhu covers for Blaze as she leaves the scene. Blaze is stopped as she tries to escape, and the one who stops her tells her her true identity: the descendant of the traitorous Grand Preceptor, who committed treason forty years ago.

The Young Chef gives Blaze a special tangerine cake, and Blaze finally puts together the entire truth of her history. Elsewhere, Ning Shu arrives at the Judicial Review Office to have an honest discussion with Yu Cheng in his prison cell about everything to do with an old case from forty years ago.

Blaze and Xingzhu finally know each other's histories. Determined to seek an explanation for everyone's sake, Blaze plans to confront the True Lung. Meanwhile, with his delivery box in hand, Young Chef gets ready to meet a very special customer.

The bestial Sui matter comes to a head. Atop the Yumen city tower, Liang Xun confesses his actions to the Grand Tutor. Inside an ancient temple outside the city, two proxies reunite after a long time.

Blaze and the True Lung finish their long conversation while Yu opens his heart to Wang. With snow falling, the great doors of the Tomb of Sui open again after a hundred and twenty years, and Wang steps inside once more.

Long ago, a twelfth, nascent consciousness emerged within the Tomb of Sui. This fledgling awareness engaged in conversation with the ancient, immense entity, filled with questions about the vast mortal realm.
In a dilapidated inn, a writer tells a fragmented tale: the greedy red dragon rouses the long-dead Exiled King, while her noble sister leads her companions back to the capital of Tara, Na Saoirsí.

Na Saoirsí is caught up in the Samhain celebrations, but Loughshinny senses that something is amiss. A statue, a 'feast', and barely hidden hatred... What she encounters drives her to meet her sister. Both of them look down at the city engulfed in violet flames.

After a falling-out with her sister, Loughshinny fails in her attempt to dispel the violet flames. Brigid wants to leave the city and go elsewhere, but gets stuck outside its gates. Dublinn, who should be upholding order in the city, only exacerbates the crisis.

Famine breaks out in the city, and hatred for the Victorians is deliberately stoked. Culann tries to distribute stored grain to maintain order, and delegates the task of finding Theo to Nemos. Nemos searches everywhere for Theo to no avail, and eventually runs into Loughshinny.

Loughshinny and Brigid search for Theo the apprentice, when they notice something suspicious about the city's grain shop owner. As night falls, Dublinn's victory celebration is about to begin… In the tavern, after another round of drinks, the greedy red dragon of the story makes its return.

Driven to madness by avarice, the Dublinners are led into the Dark Woods by the greedy red dragon. From the grain shop owner, Loughshinny and Brigid learn the truth about Theo's disappearance and the whereabouts of the smuggled food carts.

The return of the food carts does little to stem the spread of mayhem. Culann learns the truth before Loughshinny and Nemos find him, and makes the decision to destroy the statue in the middle of the square.

Culann drags the sculpture to the city square and tries to make the masses see reason, but dies surrounded by the crowd's madness. Then, purple flames burn, and Eblana descends... The first fragmented story ends here, while the curtains slowly unfurl on the second.

The statue burns in the square, and invitations to dance—both past and present—overlap as Eblana and Loughshinny face each other, separated by the departed hero in between. In the end, Loughshinny receives an agreement, and takes the deceased out of Na Saoirsí and towards the historical ruins.

With the aid of the Exiled King, Loughshinny penetrates the barrier in the Dark Woods and reunites with her companions. In the ruins, the wakemen reject Loughshinny's unspoken words, but accept the request to hold a funeral for the departed.
Eblana welcomes an unexpected guest in the city. In the ruins outside, Loughshinny witnesses a traditional Taran funeral's fire-returning ceremony.

After the funeral, the Exiled King once again appears before Loughshinny, inviting her to witness the secret within the palace ruins for herself. Loughshinny comes face to face with Tara's past, and the story of the Exiled King himself.

Casualties in the city are heavy. The flames of hatred burn furiously. Loughshinny returns to the city with Brigid. In the ruins, the wakemen and Moran talk about Tara's past. In the tavern, the unnamed woman continues the story.
The noble red dragon returns to the castle once more. To win many more futures than her own, she goes to confront the greedy red dragon, to kill her, and yet, to mourn her.
Eblana falls, but the purple fire in the city burns even fiercer. Loughshinny, Nemos, and Brigid each take their own action... Here ends the second story.
To give the story an ending, the writer begins to tell the third story: Brigid makes a bet with the Exiled King, Loughshinny confronts the dark mist, and Nemos announces the death of the Red Dragon.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: At the End of the Night
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: The curfew is broken by the rising desire to avenge the Red Dragon, until Brigid brings the wakemen back into the city. At the same time, Loughshinny continues to struggle against the dark mist. Amidst sorrow and song, the people begin to return the Red Dragon's flame.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: At the End of the Night
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: As the flames return amidst song, Loughshinny prevails over the dark mist as well as her hesitant heart and enters the purple fire, transforming the purple shade of death into an orange hue of rebirth. From the firelight the red dragon comes back to life, sending the darkness away.

Here ends the third story. The narration is now complete, and the storytellers revealed. A myth is born, and the nation of Tara rises. The one and only Red Dragon leads her people towards a new life, but her 'shadow' appears at Rhodes Island.

Sanktas living outside Laterano come down with symptoms similar to 'falling' almost simultaneously. The Shrine of Nurtury towers above Laterano, almost touching the clouds. No one remembers when it appeared, but no one questions its existence.

The second Summit of Nations gets underway, welcoming top-level delegations from every Terran nation, from Kazdel to Ægir. However, at a critical moment, an unexpected explosion occurred in Laterano. The newly-created Cardinal Lemuen is assigned to investigate the incident.

After causing an explosion in the city, Exusiai enters a confessional and corroborates the strangeness pervading Laterano, as well as the conspiracy to blow up the Shrine of Nurtury and stop the final, most important event of the Summit of Nations—the Nativity.

Laterano implements a strict arms control policy, shutting down all its firearms workshops. Exusiai arrives at one of these firearms workshops in search of materials she can use to make explosives. The Shrine of Nurtury continues to take in refugees of all races and nationalities on a large scale.

The 'Matriarch', administrator of the Shrine of Nurtury, demonstrates an all-accommodating future for Laterano to the Gun-Knight Patrizion. Exusiai convinces the firearms workshop's apprentice to help her build explosives.
Arturia escapes her captivity in Landen Monastery, and Federico gives chase. Meanwhile, Exusiai decides to infiltrate the Shrine of Nurtury by blending in with the refugees.
Lemuen's investigation of the explosion leads her to the Shrine of Nurtury, but the Matriarch rejects her offer to help with the Shrine of Nurtury's security.

Exusiai is forced to dismantle her bombs when she realizes that the Shrine of Nurtury is full of innocent refugees. During the process, she unexpectedly runs into Lemuen, who is there to investigate. At the same time, Federico finds Arturia, and both of them seem to sense something unusual stirring in Laterano.

Andoain, now working as a Nurturer for the Shrine of Nurtury, is attacked. Fiammetta and her friends save him. Fiammetta decides to drop the matter of Andoain's past actions for the time being, allowing him to complete his duties at the Nativity.

The Nativity is successfully completed. Countless eyes witness an arborbeast give birth to a fledgling with a halo. The Matriarch announces that Laterano will bestow its halo upon all. Federico and Arturia return to reality and find that all of Laterano is under the influence of a 'dream'.
'Fallen' Sanktas outside of Laterano begin to return to the city. Federico and Arturia escape the 'dream' and see a deeply anomalous Laterano.

The Matriarch invites Andoain to participate in greater things for the Shrine of Nurtury. Exusiai is arrested for attempting to sabotage the Nativity, and all the non-Sankta are taken away by gun-knights under various pretexts.

As Lemuen interrogates Exusiai, a confessional barges onto the scene to save the latter—it turns out the confessional Exusiai has been colluding with is the Doctor. Lemuen decides to let Exusiai go, as the Doctor meets up with Mon3tr to verify the cause of Laterano's various abnormalities.

Lemuen is defrocked of her cardinal's vestments after letting Exusiai go. Federico and Arturia break free of the 'dream', and realize the Pope has long since vanished. At this moment, Federico receives a mysterious request to enter the city.
The non-Sankta taken into the Shrine of Nurtury are informed that Laterano will bestow halos on them. Some refuse, but they are not given a choice.

The arborbeast mother that Andoain has been nursing dies, but his sorrow is soon wiped away. He realizes that the Matriarch has promised him a terrifying future. Federico stands off against the Sanktas errari, eventually permitting them to enter the city to assist him.

Andoain, who has come to a sudden revelation, resolves to blow up the very first room in the Shrine of Nurtury. Exusiai, with the Doctor's guidance and the help of the others, takes hold of the Matriarch and pulls her out of the 'dream'.

The 'dream' collapses, and the masses return to reality. Exusiai finds herself as part of a procession, and the Matriarch, who has reverted to the form of a Teekaz, leads that procession to the Basilica. She tells Exusiai of the origins of Laterano, and that she was the First Saint.

With the guidance of Andoain, Federico and Arturia head underground to search for the Law. Mostima and Fiammetta decide to work separately from Lemuen in their attempts to stop the procession of pilgrims. Meanwhile, Mon3tr and the Doctor get a lock on Priestess's trail.

After seeing that the Law's true form is a machine, Arturia decides to leave, while Federico and Andoain step forward for an audience. The rebels place down barrier after barrier. Exusiai tries to attack the First Saint, but the procession of pilgrims seems to be unstoppable.

The Law reveals its true nature—a PCS system created by a previous civilization—and thrusts Federico and Andoain into a simulation. The Doctor learns Priestess's true motive for coming to Laterano: to use PCS to unify all the races into one, allowing for the smoother propagation of Originium.

More and more people begin to awaken. Patrizion and the others begin to resist. Exusiai manages to defeat the First Saint. PCS reveals its plan, but Federico and Andoain point out its self-contradictory nature, and destroy it.

The upheaval of faith and the departure of God has left deep scars upon Laterano, as its people struggle to discover new reasons to live and new ways of life. Before the remnant of PCS, Exusiai makes the first wish of a new Laterano.

The Doctor and Mon3tr verify the issues plaguing Priestess, and refuse her suggestion. Priestess witnesses the birth of a true 'angel prototype' from the remains of PCS. All across Terra, omens of change begin to appear.

It is the last week of shooting for The Death of Lady Dupont, on a Wrankwood studio plate. The Messenger played by Lucian accidentally 'kills' Sir Dupont, but the blood that flows from the actor is not a prop.

The producer Greta Stone insists that Dalton's death was an accident, but the coordinator Shelly believes it is linked to an incident five years ago. Lucian is reminded of a lesson that the Troupe Leader gave him when he was young.

Lucian has long hypothesized that the Troupe Leader may have returned from the dead. The script being auctioned at Wrankwood, with the Troupe's mark on it, and the accident that occurred after he joined the cast, all seem to indicate that he has come to the right place.

Shelly begins to hallucinate on the set, putting herself in danger and rescued by Lucian at the critical moment. Lucian uses the incident as an opportunity to find out more about the accident from five years ago—the tragic death of a young actress named Laura.

Shelly leaves a movie viewing session with Tippi, the background painter, after getting a message, and dies in the cold storage section of the warehouse. Lucian sneaks into the office and discovers another deliberately concealed secret.

Tippi questions Michael, who was the last to see Shelly alive, and suspects him of being the killer. A camera assistant inquires about Lucian's secrets, only to learn that a Catastrophe is about to hit the studio plate.

Greta speaks about the accident five years ago, and persuades the film crew to go ahead with the filming of the Catastrophe. Moira corroborates Michael's alibi and tells Tippi and Marion that Michael wanted to sneak off of the plate.

Michael recalls how Laura fell to her death, and wants to escape the plate with Marion. Lucian is increasingly certain that the Troupe Leader is here. He recalls his reasons for escaping the troupe, and once again resolves to kill its leader.

Michael and Marion argue while Tippi and Moira reaffirm their friendship. A quiet night passes, but in the morning, the stagehand Hautin discovers the corpses of Michael and Marion on the set, suspended in mid-air.

The murderer's wanton violence sends the film set into a panic. Greta tells everyone of her past and to trust her vision, but disbands the crew—everyone has the right to leave, and she will finish filming with those who want to stay.

Moira suggests looking for a way to escape. Melanie seeks out Tippi to design the backdrop for her grand finale. While the script's ending is still being written, Greta meets with Lucian, hoping he will become the new leading man. Meanwhile, Steven, struggling with writer's block, hears a knock at his door...

Melanie talks about her past rivalry with Marianne, prompting Tippi to decide to help her create the perfect scene. Under the guidance of the 'God of Inspiration', Steven turns Lucian into the savior of his script, and the lead of its grand finale.

Greta realizes Lucian is not only focused on the film shoot, but also the things outside of it. She officially invites him to become the 'leading man', and to settle all that has transpired on the plate. His first step is to unmask the killer behind the serial murders—Moira.

Lucian reveals every step in Moira's vengeance for her older sister Laura, and as he closes in, Moira discovers she was never a part of Laura's life. The sabotage device Moira installed earlier takes effect, sending the plate straight towards the Catastrophe. The lives of the cast and crew are in grave peril, and there is no turning back.

The studio plate is damaged by the Originium storm. Tippi, shocked by the culprit being her good friend, decides to save the plate. At the same time, Lucian finds Moira once more, who has already descended into madness.

Lucian defeats the frenzied Moira with the Blood Diamond's song, but in doing so, he too falls into madness. Only through Miss.Christine's calming presence does he regain clarity—and uncover the one behind it all: the leader of the Crimson Troupe, long thought dead.
The Troupe Leader recounts everything that has happened on the plate and expounds on his 'aesthetics of death'. Lucian states his purpose plainly: he's here to kill him—again.

Lucian reveals the true identity of the Troupe Leader: a long-lived known as 'Tragodia'. He kills his teacher, he kills the god. But this murder ends in an inheritance—Lucian becomes the new Tragodia.

Tippi visits Moira in prison. 'Lady Dupont' rouses controversy and becomes a film festival's hottest topic. The new Tragodia, Lucian, meets the Playwright and Shalem in a cinema, and they prepare for their new journey.

A Rhodes Island operator is rescued by Scout. When he comes to, he happens to Hellagur speaking with Patriot.
Carrying the words Scout left him, the guard also makes up his mind.

W leads a team to intercept a group of defecting mercenaries. Flamebringer breaks through the conflict and leaves Reunion behind him.
At Rhodes Island, Flamebringer will meet another old friend...

Jessica completes her training under the guidance of Liskarm and Franka.
Her skills have always been excellent, but what she lacks is confidence.

The Laterano Notarial Hall deploys Executor, an undertaker, to carry out a commission in Siracusa.
Executor finds an uncooperative Vermeil there, and in accordance with the terms of the commission, takes her with him to Rhodes Island for treatment.

Ifrit and Projekt Red have another dispute over homework, resulting in Ifrit losing control of her emotions - and nearly her powers as well.
But with the help of those around her, she finally manages to regain control over herself.

An observatory in the North Pole is having some equipment abnormalities. To secure the way for future explorers, Magallan undertakes a risky maintenance mission.
However, Santalla, the operator who came to pick her up, is blocking her way.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Among the Light and the Dust
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc:
A corridor in Rhodes Island experiences a power outage, and Closure invites Kal'tsit to check the circuitry with her.
Under Closure's guidance, even Kal'tsit would confide some of her inner thoughts.
A new celebration approaches and Lungmen is vigorously making preparations, waiting for a faceless enemy only known by the name, 'Nian.'

The enemy's arrival brings great chaos and confusion, but fortunately, many passionate citizens team up with the L.G.D. to fight back the enemy. Behind the scenes, the true enemy has already bared her fangs, but in front of her stands the Catastrophe expert, Lava.

In order to reclaim the city from Nian, Rhodes Island and Lungmen join forces to make a desperate move. Just when the battle is about to reach its climax... the director decides to interrupt everything.

Vanilla drags Melantha and Steward with her to take care of her pet, and along the way, they see Blaze with a young Infected girl.
Between them, the Operators decide that after their mission, they would visit to the child who is now receiving treatment and throw a party.

Ptilopsis is writing in her diary. She always uses the diary as a way to record things she doesn't want to forget.
Except now, she would prefer to directly chat with those who she cares about.

Matterhorn obeys SilverAsh's instructions, staying home alone to prepare Cliffheart's lunch.
Matterhorn also prepares a portion for Ethan, who often comes by to scavenge, but does not expect Ethan to come bearing a surprise for him as well.

Hibiscus and Lava return home with a wanderer and temporarily entrust her with Vulcan. Vulcan decides to name her Ceobe.
Now, it is up to Ceobe to judge for herself whether she wishes to join Rhodes Island.

Orchid struggles with her decision to transfer to the Logistics Department. Midnight shares a story about his past.
No matter your past, what matters it the present, and the life you now want.

Fang goes to Dobermann's room with Beagle and Kroos and accidentally discovers some faded tags.
Dobermann rarely talks about the past, but she seems interested today.

Dur-nar points out one of Gummy's strange habits when attacking. Gummy tries to overcome it, but fails.
Her habits are all left by past trauma, and may take a bit of time to fade.

Istina tries to treat herself inside her dorm, but at that time, May knocks on her door to visit.
Accompanying May is Natalya, another member of the Ursus Student Self-Governing Group.

Zima cannot wake up from her nightmare.
She always has such dreams. She will always have such dreams.

Zima approaches Natalya, her companion in the Ursus Student Self-Governing Group. Both of them have questions to ask, as well as things they want to confide.
The problem has not been solved, but they will face the future together.

Leto, honey drunk, regales Beehunter with tales of her 'glorious past.'
There are some things that the other members of the Ursus Student Self-Governing Group may not know.

Amiya receives a request to transfer to the front lines. It is from the one member of Zima's group who is still staying behind in the Logistics Department - Natalya.
After discussion, the Doctor decides to look into the girl who submitted the application.

Zoya escapes from the occupied school, meets her father's colleagues along the way, and learns about the state of Chernobog.
She does not know if her mother still lives, and her father has gone to Peterheim Middle School to rescue the students.

Surtr and Meteorite arrive at the site of their mission, a remote mining community called Bellony Village.
In addition to their mission for Rhodes Island, Surtr is also searching for leads on her past.

Arene needs a certificate from the workshop, but the only one there is the apprentice Adnachiel. Not wanting to waste the trip, Arene asks his fellow Sankta to inspect his weapon, and the two get into a discussion about their race.
Elysium discusses a traditional Yan festival with Purestream, and the two bump into Absinthe seeking weapon maintenance advice from Thorns. During the conversation, Elysium recalls his homeland.
Mudrock brings the team to Kazdel only to find the whole team under attack by mysterious casters. To press onward, or look back into the abyss? They must make a choice.

April bumps into a Messenger talking with Ansel on her way back from a mission. She curiously strikes up a conversation with Ansel. The discussion leads her to some realizations she had never thought about before.
With Miss.Christine's guidance, a Human Resources Operator locates Phantom and asks him some questions about his file. While Phantom's answers aren't exactly lies, they do raise more questions.
Stories breed stories, which bring out even more stories. In the shadow of a festival banquet, young operators share tales passed down from ancient times.

Hoshiguma hops onto her beloved motorcycle for the first time in a while, spending one of her precious vacation days enjoying the wind, until she comes to a surprising encounter at the end of the road.
In the wilderness of the Siracusan midwest, three young men, freshly escaped from the city and driving a stolen car, embark on a new journey.
Fulfilling a twenty-year-old promise, Iris sets out to find a particular individual. Along the way, she comes across a tiny, little Oripathy patient.
Hildegard, having traveled to Lungmen looking for a solution to her monastery's financial woes, finds success. But in her spare time, finds herself musing on her connection to the world.
Operator Greyy sets out on his first field operation, alongside two of his colleagues, only to find he needs some time to adjust to the unfamiliar world outside the landship.

After leaving Lungmen, Ch'en finds herself thinking about how she should conduct herself. And after witnessing the travails of a 'criminal' in Columbia, she becomes that much more determined and sure of herself.
Utage, Myrrh, and Beanstalk chat about the strange rumors and stories surrounding Iberia while out on their operation. But the real Iberia may be quite different from the urban legends.
Two Chernobog survivors leave Ursus for the wastelands, seeking out the legendary 'Rusthammers.' However, in the wastelands, things are rarely that simple.
Heavyrain, in a rush, collapses on the border of Minos. Upon awakening, she meets a Minoan priestess, 'Pallas'.

Bena finds Annie watching Kirara play games, and out of curiosity, Bena joins in too. Upon learning that the game is based on ghost stories, Bena tells a Victorian 'ghost story' of her own to give Kirara a scare.

Blue Poison and Glaucus investigate an abandoned building to the north of Iberia and meet Indigo, who found her way to the building while she was lost. She tells them what this building once was—a lighthouse.
By chance, Carnelian witnesses an Infected girl being hunted as she leaves a noble's manor. When she learns of the runaway's predicament, she decides to give the girl a helping hand.

Worried about Pramanix's situation and the siblings' relationships, Cliffheart convinces Courier to deliver a letter to Mount Karlan in her stead. Later, Courier returns from Kjerag with an unexpected invitation.
A sudden crisis leaves the Doctor and Amiya trapped in the Columbian wastelands. Unexpected aid against unexpected plots, with many possible solutions.

A Catastrophe looms. The Doctor steps onto the bridge, as if guided by prophecy, to lead Rhodes Island through the crisis. Kal'tsit determines that though the Doctor has lost most episodic memory, a basic understanding of the nature of Originium still remains.

After the Chernobog incident, the Doctor broods over the events of the last three, breakneck months. Caught between confusion and thought, the Doctor recalls an interesting story with a fallen friend.

A rebel appears inside Babel, and the target of the attack seems to be the Doctor. Scout arrives in time and detains the intruder, but the Doctor and Theresa have different ideas for how to deal with him.
Kal'tsit recalls past events related to the doctor. Does this familiar yet foreign person really deserve her trust? The time to make an emotional choice has come.
While inspecting PRTS, Closure recalls her first encounter with Theresa and the Doctor. After she leaves, the Doctor asks an important question.
A Zalak with a red tail walks about the Grand Knight Territory. An Infected with a red tail attempts to change lives. A Knight with a red tail—has become a leader.

Ashlock Greynuty's competitor in this match is the infamous heel, 'Brassrust' Ingra. A sturdy cannon versus a sharp axe. An Infected knight versus a noble knight. Future versus past. Just which one will claim victory?

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: Let Us Ring a Ding Ding
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: 'Flametail' and 'Ashlock' want to recruit capable hands for the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, and the 'Wild Mane' Knight, who's been thrown behind bars, is a fine choice. After Wild Mane carefully observes Pinus Sylvestris, she realizes they possess ideals entirely unlike the other Knightclubs...
After rescuing the Plastic Knight from the Armorless Union, 'Fartooth' Justyna recalls the fate that befell her and the home she can't return to.
Młynar arrives at a worrying conclusion, forcing the Nearl sisters into an even more difficult predicament. 'What does it mean to be a knight?' Maria ponders to herself.
A sudden change in social status after an overnight phone call has left Malkiewicz terrified. In the end, he realizes there is no way out of his newfound responsibilities.

Young Centaurea is trying to find where her life will lead her, but as the years go by and she becomes more experienced, she realizes she never had the right to choose, and all she can do is drift about in the currents of time.
Susie, an Infected, works at the shop 'Green Spark' in the Victorian town of Caladon. Just as her dreams are about to come true, an accident extinguishes all her hope.

The vigilante Haze overhears some information not meant for her, and inadvertently gets a store burned down during her escape. She talks Susie out of suicide, but then passes out as her Oripathy flares up.
Skyfire attends an event in place of a councilor, but gets caught in a kidnapping. Realizing there's a plot driving the enemy, she casts to put a stop to it.
Despite her colleagues' opposition, Mounted Officer Grani investigates the arson at the pub. As the suspects flee, they inadvertently set off an explosion.
Quercus returns to Caladon. Susie tips off the Guards, but finds herself kidnapped before escaping during an accidental explosion. Councilor Bishmer's conspiracy at last comes to light.

Reunion hires a trader to acquire a set of control systems. The two sides almost come to blows on finding the trader ambushing a Columbian convoy to obtain the goods, but the conflict is averted when two old friends meet again.
Following the Snowcap Incident, Sciurus and Yucatan go to Victoria to represent the Browntails, and attempt to make a deal with a local magnate to rejuvenate their clan.

The day before leaving Shu for the capital, Liang Xun finally has a chance at a date with Ning Ciqiu for tea and a play in the mountains. Meanwhile, Du Yaoye, Zuo Le and others are about to set off on their own respective journeys.

Lungmen has welcomed a great number of outsiders. A wolf pack, a pack leader, a lone wolf... Slowly and quietly, they all find themselves shaped by the concrete jungle... until it is time for them to heed the call of the wild.

As planned, 'Roy the Lazurite' is about to get a face transplant and say goodbye to his old self. In the final moments of his old identity, Roy meets two young men also struggling to survive in Kazimierz's biggest city.
Guests arrive at Siesta on the eve of its imminent relocation, and Mayor Herman personally goes to greet them. A short meeting ensues between the two, both as leaders, and as fathers.

Jesselton was arrested after his cover as a prison guard was blown, and he became a typical inmate at the Mansfield State Prison. Despite the ridicule and harsh treatment he receives, he nonetheless finds his hope reignited by a letter.
After leaving the Grand Knight Territory, Młynar passes through a familiar place. Although those he seeks are nowhere to be seen, an old friend of his is.

Deszcz the attorney's business trip is heavily delayed by an unexpected vehicle breakdown. She spends the night in a village about to be sold for a rock-bottom price thanks to her own work, and gazes at a starry night sky forgotten by Kawalerielki.

Flametail and Ashlock head for border city Dzwonek and find the Infected currently being provoked there. The only one willing to talk to them is saddled with a criminal charge, and when they meet Młynar along the way, they implore him to lend a helping hand.
Laying low in Dzwonek, Szewczyk gets dragged into an explosion incident on his way to pick his son up from school.
Toland receives important corporate documents, and Młynar finds him. Realizing that their old friend is planning to assassinate the Leithanian delegate, the two of them resolve to stop him.
His plot revealed, Czcibor heads down a path of no return, while Młynar waits on his path to assassinating his target.

In the Grand Knight Territory, Margaret asks about the past after returning from a visit to her grandfather's grave. In the barrenlands, having said their goodbyes to their old friend, Młynar and Toland discuss their future.

After leaving Yumen, Qiubai searches for the remnants of the Shanhaizhong gang. Her chase leads her into their den, where she finds a child. After confirming that he only ended up there because of a misunderstanding, she decides to escort him home.

The villagers are extremely wary of Fang Xiaoshi, who left the village many years ago. In order to protect him from further danger, Qiubai stays behind and learns about a past event from the Clan Elder.
An unexpected mudslide washes away the Chidao outside the village, revealing a nameless corpse. Faced with such a tragedy, the villagers present can only fall into silence.

Just when everyone thought the scheme would go exactly as planned, Mulberry shows up with the village's Messenger in tow, sending the villagers into a panic. Faced with the prospect of the villagers running out of control, Qiubai steps back into the fray.

In the Yishan Temple, Saga hears the Village Elder's confessions, one-by-one.
Below the cliff, Qiubai rescues a boy whose name has just been killed.
A documentarian with terminal Oripathy takes up his camera and heads for a land on which he has never set foot before.

act15mini.name: The Black Forest Wills A Dream

infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Magallan applies for a permit to enter the icefield as per usual, but finds that Ursus has abruptly blocked the route. She makes her way through Sami instead, meets her old friend Santalla by an old tree, and hears from different sides about the grudges between Ursus and Sami.

Magallan encounters a supernatural phenomenon in the Fjal Vetrtonn and finds herself rescued by an unfamiliar Sarkaz. The Mountains' Sami are extremely wary of the group and chase them away from their defensive line.

The gang stops at the settlement of a friendly forest tribe and stays overnight. That night, Magallan dreams of herself becoming the prey of a shadow. Santalla helps the tribe conduct a ritual that rouses their clan tree, which rises to begin its journey with its subjects, casting a shadow that Magallan finds somewhat familiar.

Typhon teaches Magallan the wisdom of the hunter, and the laws of Sami's Eternal Hunt. They encounter a rockhorn that has been gravely wounded by a demon, and the accompanying shaman apprentice ends its suffering, but it can no longer nourish nature.
Gitano returns to her tribe after foreseeing her brother's death. Santalla tracks the trail of the Ursus infiltrators, warning Magallan and Typhon to be careful before leaving.

The funeral was held as planned, but Typhon gradually notices signs of demonic contamination during the procession of ships. Santalla arrives as promised, and halts the funeral along with Typhon. At the most critical moment, the party encounters a northern Snowpriest and his warriors.

Upon request, Typhon delivers a special flower to Magallan and the others at Rhine Lab, causing the researchers to grasp the immense scientific value of the endless icefield. Elsewhere, Santalla learns that an Ursus Royal Guard has gone rogue. To resolve this crisis, everyone's paths will converge once more.

The transport truck will soon make its last trip. Warmy works with Alanna to prepare their truck to be returned. However, still attached to the truck, she is hoping to delay its return. Almost as if in answer to her prayers, a strange passenger hijacks the truck and demands to be taken to the Grinning Valley.

Alanna contends with the truckjacker and cajoles her into bringing the truck to a checkpoint to call for help, but security officers want to board the truck to check for Infected. She pleads in vain in to protect Warmy, and ends up charging through the checkpoint gates with the truckjacker's help.

The ragtag band of accomplices stops at a nomadic platform for supplies en route to the Grinning Valley. The skittish and terrified Jerry is worried that a certain someone might catch up to him after he skipped out on his engagement, and is equally scared that the security officers from the checkpoint are out to get him. During the wild chase, he happens to find himself hiding with a woman, and the two develop feelings for each other.

Warmy's Originium Arts suddenly go out of control in the middle of nowhere. Fortunately, they happen to run into Amiya, the Doctor, and Savage after their trip down memory lane. When the incident subsides, the Rhodes Island group decides to tag along on the journey to the Grinning Valley in search of a 'Feranmut.' Ray, afraid of Warmy losing control again, finally opens her heart.

As a pitsinker, Ray works year-round in extremely oppressive environments. When her working sandbeast passes away, she sets off in a daze, seeking out the Feranmut. Once she breaks free of her dark memories, she spots a habitat with a population of lively wild sandbeasts, who bring her to a deep, secluded cave.

The road to the Grinning Valley is blocked by Originium formations, and the gang has no choice but to return empty-handed. Ray voluntarily joins Rhodes Island and tells the story of her encounter with the Feranmut when she was a child. However, Amiya glimpses the memory of somebody else from that story.

Within the Soul Furnace of Kazdel, a ceremony meant to placate the revenants instead incites their anger. The airship fires its cannons at the Furnace, and fireworks light up the night sky. Nymph, doing her best to look after a furnace node, picks up a talking firework fragment, and in doing so takes on a special task.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: The Streets on the Way Back
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Nymph visits 'the Consultant' Pohl's district in search of the revenant pieces. The gangs are fighting over a meteor and are on the verge of pulling blades. With Pohl's help, Nymph recovers the revenant fragment inside the meteor, and Pohl takes the opportunity to resolve a crisis.

A monster has been attacking passersby near some abandoned shacks. Nymph and Pohl investigate the hauntings and discover that it is a colossus made by Mudrock. Mudrock removes the Arts binding the colossus, and Nymph retrieves the revenant fragment that caused it to go berserk.

In a Sarkaz marketplace, the unconventional Crownie catches Nymph's eye. She has fashioned a revenant fragment into a gemstone brooch to go with her suit. Nymph follows her out of the city, and runs into Mostima on a delivery. After improving the design of another suit, Crownie finds she no longer needs the brooch, and gives it to Nymph.

infoUnlockDatas.storyName: The Witch and Her Afternoon Tea
infoUnlockDatas.storyDesc: Nymph and Pohl split up to investigate the last residential district. Along the way, Nymph visits Qalaiša, the Northwind Witch, who has recently moved in. While Qalaiša is away, Nymph becomes trapped in a strange dream of the witch's past. In her efforts to retrieve the revenant fragment, she accidentally destroys Qalaiša's hut.

Having returned to Kazdel, the Tin Man finds himself mistaken by Nymph and Pohl for being in possession of a revenant fragment. With Ermengarde's help, the gang enters the deepest depths of the Soul Furnace and returns all the fragments, then attempts a different kind of ceremony of appeasement. However, the Tin Man and the other revenants have other plans.

Loughshinny boards the Duke of Wellington's ship with the Doctor's help, and finally ends the ducal alliance's stalemate siege of the city as Eblana's purple flames spread onto the city walls. Loughshinny keeps her promise and returns to Tara.

After the ducal alliance enters the city, Ch'en finally locates Reunion in Londinium, now led by Nine. Reunion saves some innocents affected by the war, and also hears a call to rise up and resist from Ursus.

After the battle at the walls, the defeat of the Sarkaz has led to more chaos in the city. Nowell helps Clovisia, leader of the Self-Salvation Corps, save the innocent citizens. He witnesses her death and lets his obsession go.
A Rose Riverside's Canoe finds the trail of her missing princess in Londinium, but she does not expect yet another parting waiting for her at its end.
The Nachzehrer King makes a final stand at the Palace of Westhaleg. He lets the Doctor's group through to Theresis, and enjoys his last war alone.

As the Sarkaz troops withdraw, Catastrophe clouds appear over the capitals of all the Core nations. Amiya stops a fleet that tries to intercept the retreating Sarkaz, and Laterano's main server delivers a revelation about the future.

In the heart of Chernobog, a young girl awakens the person within the coffin - the Doctor.
The girl, named Amiya, tries to explain the situation to the Doctor, but the Reunion Movement suddenly attacks them at this time.

Dobermann, leader of the rescue team, briefs everyone on the current situation.
During the briefing, PRTS, the logistics management system of Rhodes Island, establishes contact with Amiya and reintegrates the Doctor into the system.

Chernobog has fallen into disarray. Order has collapsed, and Reunion burns and loots the city with reckless abandon.
Despite knowing that they should retreat, Rhodes Island takes action to try to save innocents.

After defeating the enemies, Amiya is feared by the civilians they just rescued - just because she is Infected.
In order to help the Doctor understand the situation, Amiya and Dobermann briefly explain the status of the Infected as well as the role of Rhodes Island.

The television stations broadcast sunny news of victory, but in reality, everything heralds the destruction of Chernobog.
But for the cautious Rhodes Island, there is still one ray of hope—

The Doctor's group encounter a member of the Ursus Military Police, when suddenly, a Reunion squad with a leader launches an attack.
Confronted by Reunion, the police have no choice but to let Rhodes Island go.

The evacuation continues. The Doctor's group finally regroups with Ace, who came to offer support.
Ace accepts the fact that the Doctor is suffering from memory loss, but says that he is still willing to accept the Doctor's orders.

The cruelty that Reunion displays chills the hearts of the operators.
However, no matter what Reunion seeks to accomplish by stirring chaos right before a Catastrophe, evacuation takes immediate priority.

While they have time to catch their breath, everyone gathers to discuss Reunion's strange behavior.
During the discussion, Dobermann warns that everything that has occurred may just be the beginning of something far more sinister if Reunion's leader is the type of person she suspects.

The panic from losing communications is starting to spread among the squad members.
The person leading the Reunion forces appears before the Doctor once more, but this time, she isn't alone.

The woman known as Crownslayer sneers and takes her leave, and in her place is a boy named Mephisto.
Mephisto, in his unparalleled arrogance, invites Rhodes Island to a deadly game.

Mephisto has the strength to back up his arrogance. Under his command, Rhodes Island's squad seems to be getting worn down.
Nearl, the Radiant Knight, arrives in just the nick of time when the situation is beginning to look bleak.

Nearl's sarcastic tone infuriates Mephisto, and a sniper named Faust demonstrates his outrageous prowess.
Faust's superb sniping abilities are terrifying, but now that the enemy has shown his hand, there is a way to fight back.

Though the breakthrough was successful, the enemy's terrible strength has left a deep impression upon everyone.
On the other hand, Mephisto and Faust take a brief break before resuming their work.

The pressure of the looming Catastrophe weighs upon the psyche of the Doctor's team, though a small back-and-forth with Nearl helps ease up the anxiety slightly.
The long journey home continues.

The Doctor's team passes by a clinic called Azazel.
Gazing upon this now empty complex, recollections of the past and the outlook of a desolate future leads many to reflect upon the conditions of the Infected.

From the point of view of an instructor, Dobermann has greater expectations for Amiya. However, she has also acknowledged the Doctor's commanding abilities.
Time is running out, and the Doctor decides to push for a frontal breakthrough.
With no time for hesitation, everyone continues to sprint forward.

The rescue squad comes to a clearing, where they see Reunion brutalizing civilians. Amiya wants to rescue them, but is stopped by Ace.
There are more important things to do, and they must move on.

A woman stands atop a tall building and takes in the herculean efforts of the Doctor and the rescue squad.
Then, as if responding to her poetic words, the sky sank into a pool of blood.

The Doctor makes a valiant effort to rescue a medic operator, and is put in harm's way in the process. Fortunately, Nearl comes to the rescue once more.
Even with an ominous storm about to fall, Reunion continues to attack.

Reunion members pour out from every nook and cranny, trapping the Doctor and the rescue squad in the city plaza.
It is at that time that Talulah, the tyrant of Reunion, approaches them.

Confronted with Talulah's oppressive power, Amiya chooses to ■ ■ ■ ■
But her power alone is not enough. Just when she is unable to hold on any longer, Ace steps out in front of her–

While Dobermann and Nearl are choked with grief, Amiya remains silent in the Doctor's arms.
They all knew... that Ace would never return home.

W pays a visit to the Doctor and the rescue party, seeing that the evacuation is about to be completed.
Amiya stands resolute when mocked by W's questions and responds with her own answer.

After one battle, W suddenly lets the party go free, with Talulah actually ordering her to not give chase.
Overcome with doubt, sorrow, and exhaustion, everyone finally sets foot on the road back home.

However, there is no time to rest. More missions await after returning to Rhodes Island.
After the operation in Chernobog, Rhodes Island receives a cooperation agreement from Lungmen. The next destination is clear.

At the quarantine gate of Lungmen District 5, the Doctor's group meets Ch'en of the L.G.D.
They follow Ch'en into the office of Wei Yenwu, the head of Lungmen, where negotiations have already begun.

The purpose of the negotiations is to establish a cooperative relationship between Rhodes Island and Lungmen to deal with the Reunion threat.
In the process, Wei Yenwu proposes a test to determine the military prowess of Rhodes Island.

Ch'en describes Rhodes Island's feats, affirming its combat capabilities. However, Wei Yenwu believes that Rhodes Island's asking price is too high.
Amiya calmly offers her remarks to the head of Lungmen, who finally seems convinced.

In the slums of Lungmen, after meeting with Liskarm and Franka, the Doctor's group receives a message from Ch'en asking them to locate an Ursus girl by the name of Misha.
Rhodes Island decides to carry out the mission.

The members of Rhodes Island find Misha in an abandoned building.
After a conversation, Misha reluctantly decides to leave with Rhodes Island.

Liskarm has her suspicions about Misha's situation, but can only follow orders for the time being.
After meeting Exusiai from Penguin Logistics, the Sankta informs them that they are in fact surrounded by the enemies.

Exusiai leads the way, scouting ahead to make sure the route is safe enough.
While waiting, Misha learns that Rhodes Island's true objective is to hand her over to the L.G.D., and believes that Amiya had lied to her.

Texas, another employee of Penguin Logistics, brings information about the retreat route.
However, Reunion's behavior once again makes everyone uneasy - their leader seems to know who Misha is.

The party retreats with Misha, and Skullshatterer, the Reunion leader, does not give chase.
Elsewhere, Exusiai leads everyone to the rooftop of a building. Her chosen route is...

It seems that it is possible to navigate the Lungmen slums by jumping from rooftop to rooftop.
However, no plan is ever flawless, and Reunion seems to have come up with the same idea. Fighting inevitably breaks out.

After breaking through Reunion's forces, Rhodes Island successfully transfers Misha to the L.G.D.
However, the high intensity movement from before seems to take an immense toll on Misha's body, and her physical condition worsens.

The medical team believes that Misha is suffering from an acute flare-up of Oripathy that requires immediate treatment.
However, a conflict breaks out between Reunion and ordinary Infected people.

Although they did rescue some people, the homes they destroyed could not be restored, leaving everyone at a loss.
In order to complete the agreement with Lungmen, the group needs to move on.

Rhodes Island hands Misha over to Lungmen's custody after meeting up with Ch'en. Amiya waves goodbye to Misha, promising to meet her again.
For the time being, things seems to draw to an end.

Amiya had the premonition that things would not end so easily, however.
Elsewhere, a conversation between Crownslayer and Talulah suggests that something major is about to happen.

The number of Reunion members who have infiltrated Lungmen is beyond imagination, and their actions are becoming increasingly brazen.
Under Skullshatterer's command, they took the initiative to launch an attack against Rhodes Island.

Amiya decides to retreat, but Skullshatterer already had a team in place waiting for them.
Elsewhere, Ch'en informs Misha about the reason why she is sought after by both sides. As everyone knows, a crisis is looming on the horizon.

As Skullshatterer closes in on them, Rhodes Island is gradually forced into a dead end.
In response to Skullshatterer's hateful accusations and questioning, Amiya gives a resounding response, signalling yet another imminent battle.

Reunion retreats, but not for any reason pertaining to their combat ability.
On another front, Ch'en is informed that all reinforcements have been cut off by just a single enemy.

After regrouping, Amiya learns that Misha has been kidnapped by W. Amiya presses Ch'en for the truth, and the latter finally reveals Misha's secret.
This time, the L.G.D. decides to join forces with Rhodes Island.

Reunion's infiltration into Lungmen is unpredictable and unpreventable, but everyone is clear that the primary objective is to bring Misha back.
Rhodes Island leads the charge, Penguin Logistics backs them up, and the L.G.D. make up the main force. The battle lines are drawn, and the operation officially begins.

Hoshiguma from the Special Ops Team of the L.G.D. joins up with the party.
The chivalrous Hoshiguma offered candid praise for Rhodes Island before charging into battle.

Misha and Skullshatterer finally meet again, but nothing is as it used to be.
Skullshatterer's hateful accusations leave Misha feeling a sense of unfamiliarity towards the person she once knew, but she can't help but to feel a thread of empathy.

The duo of Exusiai and Texas create chaos within the enemy ranks, drawing most of the enemy's attention to themselves.
Elsewhere, Rhodes Island's team finally arrives and prepares to head into battle—

Rhodes Island's attack forces Skullshatterer into action. Faced with Misha's apprehension, he gives his denial without hesitation.
Even W offers a plan of her own.
Franka easily sees through the ambush that Reunion is planning, and Rhodes Island decides to press forward and seize victory.

However, the ambush was intended to be a distraction, and everything was to set the stage for a single lethal blow against the Doctor.
Even though the first hit is blocked, the second flies towards the Doctor, about to find its mark—

Amiya lashes out violently, and in a flash of sparks and flame, Skullshatterer falls to the ground.
Reunion rushes back, disregarding everything to bring back Skullshatterer's body.

W is surrounded by Rhodes Island, but her role is simply to hand a mobile phone to Amiya.
The voice on the other side of the line belongs to Misha, but this time, her voice is clear and decisive.

Time waits for no man; the only thing that can be done now is to continue to act.
After detecting Reunion's location, Rhodes Island and the L.G.D. split up to launch separate operations.

Skullshatterer lies there dying and Mephisto, the one capable of healing him, is nowhere to be seen.
W quips that the troops have lost all will to fight and asks Misha to follow her to safety. However, Misha disagrees.

Franka, Liskarm, and Hoshiguma all display their talents on the battlefield.
After joining forces with Amiya's team that had successfully broken through the front entrance, the only obstacle that remains in front is—

Franka searches the camp, but finds no trace of Misha.
Nearby, the Skullshatterer that should have been slain stands once more.

The thoughts of the two sides are like parallel lines. Though they both run straight, they will never intersect.
Even if Amiya recognizes 'Skullshatterer,' there is no path forward from here.

'Skullshatterer' collapses once more, but not a single person is smiling. Ch'en has no words of comfort for Amiya, but shares some of her seldom-spoken sentiments.
With conflicted emotions, everyone begins their journey back home.

Amiya seems tired and confused after returning to Rhodes Island. Kal'tsit gives the Doctor a clue about the secret etched upon Amiya's body.
After a brief respite, they are faced with a new challenge.

In the ruins of a satellite city of Chernobog, a team consisting of Meteorite, Frostleaf, and Jessica are carrying out an exploration mission.
Back at the bridge of Rhodes Island, Amiya bids a temporary farewell to her friends from Blacksteel and Penguin Logistics.

In the ruins, Meteorite's team encounters Reunion forces remaining behind in the city.
After reporting in with Kal'tsit, the team continues their mission. Frostleaf notices that there is something abnormal about the temperature.

In the slums, Amiya meets an Infected child, whose liveliness once against gives her pangs of indecision. 
She also runs into Ch'en, but this Ch'en has a look in her eyes that is nothing like that of the person she knows.

After reuniting with the Doctor, Amiya seems to have changed. Though still confused, she seems to have a clearer direction.
Shortly afterwards, they receive a message from Kal'tsit, notifying them that something has just happened.

In the ruins of the abandoned city, Meteorite's team encounters a unique Reunion squad.
This team is likely responsible for the sudden drop in temperature, reminding Frostleaf of a legend she heard about the mythical 'Yetis.'

After exchanging information with Ch'en, Amiya proposes a joint operation with the L.G.D., Ch'en quickly shoots down her proposal.
At this time, Jessica sends a message, stating that they've found two Reunion leaders - Mephisto and Faust.

After being discovered, Meteorite's team tries to fight back but are ruthlessly suppressed by Mephisto while the Yeti Squad closes in.
With the situation looking hopeless, Frostleaf issues a dire warning to Amiya — stay away.

Meteorite's team was not the only one that was attacked. The other recon squads had all been attacked.
Even Ch'en was forced to admit that the situation could afford no delay.

Ch'en finally stops being stubborn and agrees to cooperate with Rhodes Island.
After communicating with Kal'tsit, Amiya decides to rescue Meteorite's team.

Amiya's team arrives at the satellite city ruins, and discovers the alarming situation in the city.
During the conversation, someone catches Ch'en's attention, prompting her to give chase alone. Amiya's team tries to follow her, but are blocked by Reunion combatants.

After the battle, Ch'en is already nowhere to be seen.
Given the risks posed by operating in an Originium-rich environment, Amiya leads Rhodes Island deeper into the city after communicating with Hoshiguma, having the L.G.D. stay on the periphery to serve as support.

Being able to find traces of battle left behind by Meteorite's team is slightly reassuring, but the information that Kal'tsit brings is a mix of good and bad news.
The group continues to advance, and Kal'tsit seems to have a plan of her own.

The team finally locates Ch'en and persuades her to return to the L.G.D.
But Rhodes Island still needs to rescue Meteorite's team, meaning that they will have to fight alone.

The team meets Frostleaf first at the designated coordinates.
Frostleaf explains that the situation is complicated and cannot be explained immediately. The most pressing matter is to rescue Meteorite and Jessica.

Frostleaf leads the way, helping the team find Meteorite and Jessica. However, Jessica seems to be traumatized by something she saw.
Under Amiya's guidance, she is able to gradually leave the terror behind her.

Mephisto suddenly reappears before anyone has the time to take a sigh of relief. Under his words, Reunion once again declared its existence to the world.
This time, Amiya decides that she won't run away any longer.

Despite the momentum of Amiya's team, Mephisto seems to face no pressure at all.
Right when Mephisto is about to be struck, the entire world freezes over in the blink of an eye. FrostNova has arrived.

FrostNova's overwhelming power forces the group into a fight for their survival.
But now more than ever, it's do or die.

Frostleaf's valiant efforts finally give a chance for Amiya a chance to break through, and everyone is able to retreat at last.
However, when they return, they quickly find out that Lungmen itself is in grave peril...

Ch'en, who just woke up from a nightmare, finds herself inside the Rhodes Island landship with her colleage, Swire, standing next to her.
Judging from Swire's account, Ch'en had been attacked by enemies earlier.

While quarreling with Swire, Ch'en gradually begins to comprehend the crisis in Lungmen.
As they say in Lungmen, 'everything has gone to shit.'

Swire may not be as bad as she seems, but the situation in Lungmen is exactly as bad as it seems.
After a confidential communication, Ch'en decides to ask Rhodes Island for help.

Ch'en responds to the blame and doubt, but Hoshiguma sees through her hesitation.
But at least, she now knows what she has to do.
Ch'en and Hoshiguma set out to rescue the informant, Phal.

Though Ch'en and Hoshiguma move quickly, they are still one step too late.
Saying his last words, Phal slowly closed his eyes.

Ch'en and Hoshiguma arrive at the location indicated by the intelligence and plan out their next action.
The two spring to action after discovering Reunion activity.

After defeating the Reunion members there, Ch'en realizes that she has come to her old home.
Ch'en reflects upon past events, but her mood soon improves as she gains some more clues.

Reunion forces occupying a mall in Lungmen are wary that things are perhaps going a bit too well.
But before their doubts have a chance to sink in, the L.G.D. is already mounting a counterattack.

The L.G.D. makes quick work of the enemies in front of them, but an enemy caster suddenly blows up the ground beneath Ch'en's feet.
Ch'en plummets down the tall building.

Ch'en regains consciousness to see Hoshiguma protecting her from broken walls and rubbles. Though she is saved, both of them have sustained heavy injuries.
Facing the enemy onslaught, the two draw their weapons once more.

Aftering relaying Hoshiguma's position to the medic team, Ch'en continues to move forward.
She communicates with her subordinates and Swire before taking her forces towards the L.G.D. Headquarters.

The state of Reunion's presence in the L.G.D. Headquarters seems strange, but that is not enough to stop the L.G.D.'s advance.
Mephisto has been waiting for them on the roof.

At first glance, Mephisto appears to be cornered. But with just a few words, the entire situation is turned on its head.
Despite the sudden shift in fortunes, Ch'en still has a back-up plan—

Chi Xiao finally is unsheathed, and the scales tip in the L.G.D.'s favor once more.
However, a momentary slip in focus causes Chi Xiao to rampage out of control. Just then, Rhodes Island arrives at the critical moment.

The grand entrance of Rhodes Island's elite operator, Blaze, quickly turns the battle one-sided. Seeing that nothing else can be done, Faust pulls Mephisto from the battlefield.
And thus, another situation draws to an end.

Wei Yenwu's calculations and ruthlessness are terrifying, but evident are his qualifications as the Chief of Lungmen.
Rhodes Island chooses to continue to cooperate for its own goals.

Rhodes Island and the L.G.D. officially begin their campaign against Reunion.
Elsewhere in Lungmen, Blaze stands against a squad of Reunion members.

Blaze dispatches of the enemy and groups up with Amiya. With her is GreyThroat, an operator who Blaze seems to have some bad blood with.
Elsewhere, Ch'en and Swire fight side-by-side again.

The old memories that GreyThroat stirred up cause Blaze to have second thoughts.
However, the top priority is to deal with Reunion.

After resolving the issue with Reunion, Blaze presses forward with the Doctor.
Elsewhere, Ch'en and Swire talk about a certain informant who seems to be a mutual acquaintance.

Mephisto displays his Arts, causing his Herd to become even more frenzied, and even launches indiscriminate attacks.
Faust cannot bear the sight any longer and takes matters into his own hands.

Faust and GreyThroat draw their crossbows on one another. GreyThroat's naivete gives him some pause.
In the end, he can't find it in him to pull the trigger, and lets GreyThroat leave.

The L.G.D. receives some help from a mysterious official and are granted a moment's respite.
Elsewhere, a mysterious figure clad in black is also making its move, leaving no survivors.

In a run-down room, a Reunion member is currently talking to a woman.
They talk about the past and the present, and finally, the Reunion member offers the woman an invitation to leave Lungmen together.

Under the withering assault of Mephisto's Herd, Amiya makes the decision to set them free.
Elsewhere, Ch'en catches up with a mysterious figure clad in a black raincoat and recognizes who it is. After a confrontation, the other party temporarily makes a compromise.

Crownslayer is suddenly attacked. Swire tries to interrogate Lin Yuxia about the 'Black Raincoat' troops, but the other party hangs up on her. Mephisto is taken away by Faust's crossbowmen.
Events are spiralling out of control everywhere.
An account of the childhood of Mephisto and Faust, and their encounter with Talulah.

The operation proceeds smoothly, and Blaze discovers Faust's location. In addition to satisfying the terms of the agreement, Ch'en decides to do something about the special forces in black raincoats.
Faust chooses to sacrifice himself for Mephisto.

Faust is dead.
GreyThroat retrieves his crossbow.

Earlier, Rhodes Island confronted FrostNova's squad.
While Reunion pursues Rhodes Island, Blaze arrives and holds off FrostNova and the Yetis alone.

Blaze and FrostNova are evenly matched, but the building collapses in the aftermath of the battle. The Doctor and Frostnova both tumble into the void.
Rhodes Island strikes a temporary truce with the Yeti Squadron.
Returning to the present, Reunion seems to have re-organized and is moving again. A woman named 'Nine' has decided to leave Lungmen, and Ch'en leads the black raincoat squad to the Yeti Squadron.

Facing the combined offensive of the L.G.D. and the black raincoats, the Yeti Squadron defends their only way out.
FrostNova taps deep into her Arts to stave off the enemies, but her body has reached its limit.

GreyThroat puts herself in harm's way to protect a group of children. Fortunately, Blaze comes to the rescue.
After a conversation, they manage to ease some of the tension between them.

Projekt Red's ferocity suppresses Crownslayer, and Kal'tsit's overwhelming power makes resistance seem futile.
